notes.title: The game's release on mobile devices!
Fresh update: Extended ending
notes.notes:
Friends!

We thank you for the interest in our novel and productive feedback! Paying close attention to your reviews, we noticed how invested many of you were in the girls' fate during the course of the game. This helped us realize that Haruko Kotonoha's story seemed incomplete, so we decided to expand on it, adding detail to the heroine's true ending.

Update your game and follow the path to the eponymous "Haruko" ending, so that you can finish the heroine's story on a more positive note!

notes.title: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life | Full version is available!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Am51whY0SmU;full][/previewyoutube]

One day, after dozing off aboard a train in Estonia, regular guy Maxim Laas mysteriously wakes up in another person's body — in Japan, no less. He's about to spend a few unforgettable days as a Japanese university student and meet two lovely girls: Kyoko Shihane and Haruko Kotonoha. Both of them have their own unique personalities and stories, filled with drama and emotions.

Two girls, two hearts, two fates: who will Maxim choose? Play now and make your choice!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546060/My_Summer_Adventure_Memories_of_Another_Life
